title: Effectiveness of Social Safeguards in Curbing Problem Gambling
what_it_is: Effectiveness of Social Safeguards in Curbing Problem Gambling

sections.label: Casino safeguards exclude vulnerable people
sections.summary: Casino safeguards disallow financially vulnerable people, including undischarged bankrupts, financial aid recipients and HDB rental flat tenants with rental arrears, from entering casinos.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Our casino safeguards are among the most stringent in the world.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We take a preventive approach by disallowing the most financially vulnerable people from entering the casinos.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: For example, undischarged bankrupts, those who are receiving financial aid from the Government, such as ComCare Social Assistance or legal aid, and those living in Housing and Development Board rental flats who have six months or more of rental arrears, are automatically excluded.

sections.label: Problem gambling prevalence estimate
sections.summary: Problem gambling is estimated to affect slightly under 1% of the resident population.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: As a result, problem gambling is estimated to only affect slightly under 1% of the resident population.

sections.label: Higher casino entry levies, patron measures
sections.summary: From 4 April, daily and annual casino entry levies for Singaporeans and Permanent Residents rose 50%, and measures with the Integrated Resorts will inform patrons and train staff.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: For casino gambling, with effect from 4 April this year, the casino entry levies for Singaporeans and Permanent Residents have been raised by 50%, from $100 to $150 for the daily levy, and from $2,000 to $3,000 for the annual levy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We will also be working with the Integrated Resorts (IRs) to implement technology measures to provide patrons with information to allow them to make informed decisions on their bets and better control their gambling expenditure.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We will also work with the IRs to strengthen training for casino gaming staff to identify persons at-risk of gambling problem and offer help to such patrons.
